policy: Track the incident semantics without cherry-picking the hotfix production implementation.

newCases.sourceTest: parses compact ATP feeder alternatives as singles instead of a doubles team
newCases.requiredOutcome: Parse compact alternative singles candidates without converting them into a doubles team.

newCases.sourceTest: filters a labeled ATP junior side event without dropping adjacent tour finals
newCases.requiredOutcome: Classify the side event separately while retaining adjacent tour finals; this must not become a blanket junior exclusion.

newCases.sourceTest: finished feeder matches resolve ATP OOP alternatives before fixtures publishes the final
newCases.requiredOutcome: Resolve provisional OOP participant candidates from finished feeder evidence with provenance.

newCases.sourceTest: an unresolved ATP feeder choice is displayed once per candidate
newCases.requiredOutcome: Preserve a provisional slot and display each candidate once without inventing identity.

newCases.sourceTest: watches the active official day, Beijing today and tomorrow independently
newCases.requiredOutcome: Observe active official day, current Beijing day, and following day independently.

newCases.sourceTest: uses five-minute fixture retries for unresolved OOP rows and hourly prefetch for tomorrow
newCases.requiredOutcome: Use capability/state-aware refresh policy without embedding page-state rules in an adapter.

newCases.sourceTest: refreshes a stale non-active current day instead of freezing its first prefetch
newCases.requiredOutcome: Refresh stale prefetched schedule data without switching the active projection day.

newCases.sourceTest: an old OOP-only scheduled anomaly cannot freeze the previous date forever
newCases.requiredOutcome: A stale uncorroborated OOP anomaly cannot block official-day advancement indefinitely.

newCases.sourceTest: advances after every source match is cancelled even though cancelled cards are hidden
newCases.requiredOutcome: Projection filtering of cancelled cards cannot hide source completeness from day advancement.

strengthenedExistingCases.baselineTest: invalidates snapshots created by the old competitor-driven pipeline
strengthenedExistingCases.sourceTest: invalidates snapshots and parsed OOP rows from an incompatible pipeline
strengthenedExistingCases.requiredOutcome: An incompatible pipeline/schema version invalidates derived OOP state while preserving separately durable terminal evidence.
